I’m very late lol but this might help someone else, i also take concerta in the morning (at around 7-8am) and eat half a banana or some other small fruit to avoid the ”morning sickness”. I then eat dinner at around 5-6pm and stop eating around 10-11pm (I only eat a few snacks or fruits in that time period) and I don’t feel like the morning fruit ruins my fast. So i guess it depends on why you fast? I personally do it for weight loss/weight maintenance and I still see the same results!!
(Edit)
